features: typed activity, activity concentration, time, mass, flow and rate boundaries
source-disjoint four-exponential population blood input convolved with recorded injection duration
interchangeable reversible two-tissue compartments for lung, liver and kidney
explicit renal excretion to urinary-bladder activity
exact requested-frame averaging over deterministic RK4 states

blood.source: doi:10.1186/s40658-022-00490-y; population h4 impulse-response coefficients, independent of HedyPET

lung.source: doi:10.1155/2014/807167 normal-lung simulation table; independent of HedyPET

liver.source: doi:10.1155/2014/807167 normal-liver simulation table; independent of HedyPET

kidney.source: doi:10.1007/s00259-024-06879-4 normal-tissue table plus explicit structural assumptions; independent of HedyPET

declared_assumptions: The population blood kernel is normalized and scaled by injected activity divided by an allometric cardiac-output reference; this is not a fitted individual arterial input function.
Liver vascular fraction 0.20, organ volumes, kidney irreversible k4=0 and renal-excretion rate 0.10 min^-1 are engineering reference assumptions, not qualification evidence.
All tissue coefficients are construction inputs from non-HedyPET publications and are never refitted against HedyPET outcomes.
The bladder is a one-way activity accumulator without voiding, urine volume dynamics or ureter delay.
uncertainty_plan: structural variants including kidney reversibility and bladder voiding

decision.allowed_claim: A typed, deterministic, source-disjoint injection-to-frame FDG/PET candidate is computationally qualified and immutably frozen before any HedyPET participant outcome is inspected.
